items.title: General Dynamics (GD) Appoints Amy Johnson As GDIT President
items.summary: General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) has appointed Amy Johnson as president of its General Dynamics Information Technology segment. Johnson brings a background in technical leadership, with responsibilities spanning cybersecurity, defense electronics, space, and intelligence systems at GDIT. The leadership transition places Johnson at the center of execution for one of General Dynamics' major operating segments.
